newsitem.title: USA: Samsonite stake cut by Cooperman group.
newsitem.headline: Samsonite stake cut by Cooperman group.

text.p: A group led by New York investor Leon Cooperman said Tuesday it reduced its stake in Samsonite Corp to 7.1 percent or 1,136,412 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 280,000 shares of Samsonite between October 3 and November 8 at prices ranging from $29.56 to $38 a share.

The group, which previously held an 8.9 percent stake in the luggage company, includes Omega Capital Partners L.P., Omega Institutional Partners, Omega Equity Partners L.P. and Omega Overseas Partners Ltd, all investment firms controlled by Cooperman.
